queueContract.idleWhen: reviewRequest is null, or referenced expectedReceipt already exists
queueContract.processing: For each READY job, personally inspect exact full cards, bound source contexts in complete saved source bodies, and meaningful global semantic peers. Write one immutable receipt only to exact expectedReceipt. INITIAL must precede application. FINAL must hash exact CURRENT cards matching same-version candidate/binding or the one authorized directed fix. Never exceed one fix-cycle per ID. Evidence budget is one primary source attempt plus one official alternative per missing claim; do not fetch when saved sources suffice; otherwise report missing support.

writeBoundary: reviewer/*.json receipts only; never edit author files, catalog, manifest, source bodies, candidates, bindings or peers.
completion: When manifest.taskCompleted is true, stop queue polling and finish with a concise handoff. If a genuine reviewer agent/context/tool blocker occurs, write one immutable reviewer/protocol-blocked-*.json preserving existing receipts and constraints; do not invent PASS or spawn another reviewer.
idleBehavior: While no pending request, wait 30 seconds with clock.sleep, then re-read the same manifest field. No content work or repeated status narration while idle.
